title: Stay, Stay, Stay
original_lyrics:
[verse]
I'm pretty sure we almost broke up last night
I threw my phone across the room, at you
I was expecting some dramatic turn away

[bridge]
This morning I said we should talk about it

[chorus]
That's when you came in wearing football helmet
And said okay let's talk
And I said...
Stay, stay, stay
I've been loving you for quite some
Time, time, time
You think that it's funny when I'm
Mad, mad, mad

[bridge]
Who took all of their problems out on me

[bridge]
I love you because you have given me no choice but to
Stay, stay, stay
I've been loving you for quite some
Time, time, time
You think that it's funny when I'm
Mad, mad, mad

[bridge]
Stay, stay, stay, stay
-once
You took the time to memorize me
-once
My fears, my hopes and dreams
I just like hanging out with you
All the time
-once
All those times that you didn't leave
-once
It's been occuring to me
-once
I' like to hang out with you
-once
For my whole life
Stay, and I'll be loving you for quite some...time
No one else is gonna love me when I get
Mad, mad, mad

[chorus]
Stay, stay, stay, stay, stay, stay
Stay, stay, stay
I've been loving you for quite some
Time, time, time
You think that it's funny when I'm
Mad, mad, mad

[bridge]
Stay, stay, stay, stay, stay, stay
Stay, stay, stay
I've been loving you for quite some
Time, time, time
You think that it's funny when I'm
Mad, mad, mad
